stem: A familiar brand of pesticide has a new concentration and label revision. A coworker suggests using last season's mixing and PPE notes because the brand name is unchanged. What is the best response?
choices: Stop and verify the exact current label/SDS and applicable requirements for the product in hand
Use the old notes because the brand name is the same
Use half the old amount to compensate
Ask a social-media group which rate they prefer
rationale: Product identity, formulation and current source version must match the task. Familiarity with a brand does not substitute for current verification.
